text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was keeping Mejiro 
Bright company as she sunbathed under the 
chilly sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~. There is something I have not 
understood for the longest time.
choice_data_list: Something you haven't understood f...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yeees. Whenever I speak with Lady Ramonu—
choice_data_list: Something you've never been able t...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, it is said that by intertwining 
their tails, they convey their affection 
for one another~”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "...Love is something spoken on the turf."

text_block_list.name: Bright's Friend
text_block_list.text:
""W-W-Wait, Bright-chan!? A tail hug on 
Ramonu-san!? That's gone way past amazing 
and straight into terrifying...!""

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "Howa~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's pretty much how it went~
Even 
when I was a kid...”

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Ramonu, Lady Ramonu~. What kind of 
book are you reading~? May I stay by your 
side~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Servant
text_block_list.text:
""! B-Bright-sama...!? Ramonu-sama is 
concentrating on her book. You shouldn't 
disturb her...!""

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: "Howawa~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm with Lady Ramonu, for some 
reason people are always startled or try 
to stop us~ It's been like that ever
since 
we were little kids~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why I haven't understood it for 
the loooongest time. Why could that be~?"
choice_data_list: You've been struggling with this f...
You've been struggling with this f...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I feel like the answer to her 
question is pretty clear.
What everyone is 
probably thinking is—
choice_data_list: You've been agonizing over this fo...
You've been agonizing over this fo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is terrified. Of having their 
very self melted away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady Ramonu~! Good day. Are you out 
for a stroll~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear~... What a pity. I could have 
joined you if it were just a walk~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Until next time, then. Let's make a pinky 
promise~♪
choice_data_list: (...Admittedly, this might be pret...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's overwhelming ability and 
aura. Even as an adult, I find myself 
involuntarily intimidated by it.
choice_data_list: (...This really might be amazing, ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Mejiro Bright treats her just as 
she always does. Naturally, following the 
whims of her own heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~.
Pinky promise with Ramonu-sama~♪ A 
promise~ to go for a stroll~♪
choice_data_list: ...Don't you get nervous facing Ra...
...Don't you get nervous facing Ra...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
? To Ramonu-sama~? No, I certainly shall 
not~.
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you nervous facing Ramonu?
...Don't you get nervous going aga...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Not getting nervous against Mejiro 
Ramonu." To someone intimidated by her, 
that alone looks incredible.
choice_data_list: That's definitely what's so 'amazing'.
That's definitely what's so 'amazi...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Aww, I see. So that's what was going 
on~
choice_data_list: On the other hand, how come you ar...
On the other hand, how come you ar...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, that is a simple matter~.
choice_data_list: On the flip side, why aren't you n...
On the flip side, why aren't you n...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Because to me, Ramonu-sama is a truly, 
ve~ry kind person~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...When my 'tail hug' was turned down,
we 
raced together afterwards~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu personally taught me how to 
express love through racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Always with utter seriousness~. Besides, 
even back in our childhood...

text_block_list.name: Young Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind, as long as you stay quiet."

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: ""! Yes-siree, I promise~!♪""

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Kindness is not something merely 
given; it is something to be received."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah... At long last, I truly understand 
from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone else must have simply
overlooked 
it. Ramonu-sama's kindness, that is."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu's kindness is just a tiny bit 
easier to make her drop than anyone 
else's, after all~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So overwhelming that one cannot take it
in 
without standing by her side.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, that's true.
...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was indeed so intimidated and tense
that 
I might have overlooked that "kindness."
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, that's true.
...Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it feels like a bit of a waste~. 
For Lady Ramonu's kindness to simply be 
lost like this.”
choice_data_list: (If I stay by her side without fea...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~. Is there anything I might be 
able to help with~?
choice_data_list: Shall we show them how much more w...
Shall we show them how much more w...
Shall we show them how much more w...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Ramonu, did you know? Carrots 
actually have lo~ng leaves attached to 
them~."
choice_data_list: Shall we show them by eating toget...
Shall we show them by training tog...
Shall we show them by hanging out ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And I hear it's edible, too~ If the 
opportunity arises, I would love to share 
a meal with you~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You're right.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Those two have been eating together a lot 
lately, haven't they~? I'm surprised 
Ramonu-san doesn't mind it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because Bright-chan is like a 
little sister to you? You have a bit of a 
big sister side too,
huh. ...My impression 
of you might have changed a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Is that all? Is that the depth of your 
love?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Ufufu. Not quite yet~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, those two are running together again. 
...I'm kinda jealous, maybe~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey... If I get the chance, would it be 
okay if I... tried talking to them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer~, what do you think? I drew the 
three of us—myself, you, and 
Ramonu-sama—standing side by side.
choice_data_list: That's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. Aren't we greedy?
choice_data_list: It's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they're drawing together again~ They 
get along so well.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey. I thought Ramonu-san hated other 
people... Is that really not the case, I 
wonder?
